ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, the quadrilateral $ABCD$ is inscribed in a circle, with extensions of two pairs of opposite sides intersecting at points $E$ and $F$, respectively, and $\angle E=40^\circ$, $\angle F=60^\circ$. What is the measure of $\angle A$ in degrees?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Connect EF, as shown in the figure, \\
$\because$ Quadrilateral ABCD is inscribed in a circle, $\therefore \angle$ECD$=\angle A$, \\
$\because \angle$ECD$=\angle 1+\angle 2$, $\therefore \angle A=\angle 1+\angle 2$, \\
$\because \angle A+\angle 1+\angle 2+\angle E+\angle F=180^\circ$, \\
$\therefore 2\angle A+40^\circ+60^\circ=180^\circ$, \\
$\therefore \angle A=\boxed{40^\circ}$.

Reasoning: Let the four minor arcs AB=x, BC=y, CD=z, DA=w. By the theorem of the angle between two secants outside a circle, for point E, there is ∠E=1/2(arc AB−arc CD), so x−z=80. method.method_draft: Use arc measures and the external secant angle theorem. From the image, read that the cyclic order is A-B-C-D, point E is the intersection of the extensions of AD and BC, and point F is the intersection of the extensions of AB and CD. Let the minor arc measures be arc AB = x, arc BC = y, arc CD = z, arc DA = w. Since E is formed by two secants E-D-A and E-C-B, use the exterior secant formula: angle E = 1/2(arc AB - arc CD), so x - z = 80. Since F is formed by secants F-B-A and F-C-D, angle F = 1/2(arc DA - arc BC), so w - y = 120. Also x+y+z+w=360. Substitute x=z+80 and w=y+120 to get 2(y+z)+200=360, hence y+z=80. Finally, angle A is an inscribed angle intercepting arc BCD, so angle A = 1/2(y+z)=40 degrees.

method.method_draft: Use directed line angles. From the image, take AB as a horizontal reference ray pointing right and let angle A = t, so the ray AD has direction t above AB. At E, the line BC is 40 degrees steeper than AD in the displayed configuration, so the direction of ray B to C is t+40 degrees. At F, line CD makes 60 degrees with the extension of AB, and in the figure ray C to D points up-left, so its direction is 180-60=120 degrees. Therefore at C, the interior angle between ray C to B, whose direction is t+40+180=t+220 degrees, and ray C to D, direction 120 degrees, is (t+220)-120=t+100 degrees. Because ABCD is cyclic, opposite angles A and C are supplementary: t+(t+100)=180. Solve to get 2t=80, so t=40 degrees.

推理：按指定方法，用有向直线角处理。取 AB 为水平向右的参考射线，设 ∠A=t，因此射线 AD 的方向角为 t。由图中 E 点处，直线 BC 相对于 AD 在显示构型中多倾斜 40°，所以从 B 指向 C 的射线方向角为 t+40°。在 F 点处，CD 与 AB 的向右延长线夹角为 60°；而图中从 C 指向 D 是向左上方，所以射线 CD 的方向角为 180°-60°=120°。于是，在 C 点，射线 C 到 B 的方向角是 (t+40°)+180°=t+220°，射线 C 到 D 的方向角是 120°，所以 ∠C=(t+220°)-120°=t+100°。因为 ABCD 是圆内接四边形，对角互补，所以 ∠A+∠C=180°，即 t+(t+100°)=180°。解得 2t=80°，t=40°。因此 ∠A=40°。
